Role Title: TripIt Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging experienced TripIt Specialists to contribute to a customer's travel-focused project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This engagement is well-suited for professionals who have mastered TripIt and excel at organizing complex travel itineraries, booking travel arrangements, and managing trip details. You'll demonstrate end-to-end travel management workflows, providing valuable insights for AI development and workflow optimization.

Scope of Work

  1. Create, manage, and optimize detailed travel itineraries using TripIt based on provided guidelines and scenarios.
  2. Demonstrate the organization and integration of flight, hotel, and ground transportation bookings within TripIt.
  3. Showcase advanced itinerary management, including updates, modifications, and handling changes in travel plans.
  4. Document and explain step-by-step processes for trip planning, itinerary adjustments, and travel information consolidation.
  5. Analyze and provide feedback on the effectiveness and efficiency of TripIt workflows for travel management purposes.
  6. Collaborate with project coordinators to deliver clear written and verbal explanations of your methods and results.
  7. Support the creation of reference materials and workflow examples for AI model training and evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated expertise using TripIt for end-to-end travel planning and itinerary management.
  2. Strong background in travel organization, including multi-city or complex travel scenarios.
  3. Current and active access to TripIt, with proficiency in all major features and functionalities.
  4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes clearly and concisely.
  5. Experience in consolidating and managing multiple booking sources within TripIt.
  6. Familiarity with common travel booking platforms and travel management best practices.
  7. Comfortable demonstrating workflows and providing detailed feedback for technical audiences.
